capabilities.why: Safety hooks intercept and inspect every shell command before it reaches the guest microVM kernel, enabling proactive blocking of destructive patterns and malicious exfiltration.
Strict network policy isolates the microVM sandbox by severing outbound internet connectivity, preventing prompt-injected packages and scripts from leaking environment credentials or keys.
MicroVM hardware snapshots allow full CPU, memory, and disk checkpointing prior to risky code execution, enabling instantaneous rollback when midway task steps fail or crash.
